# Blinkoair

> Blinkoair is an independent U.S. online travel agency for booking flights,
> built around honest, all-in pricing (taxes included, service fee shown before
> you pay) and 24/7 human phone support. Blinkoair is not an airline.

## What Blinkoair is
- An independent travel agency (not an airline, not an airline affiliate).
- Fares include base fare + mandatory airline taxes; a per-ticket service fee is
  disclosed before payment. Eligible tickets are cancellable within 24 hours of
  booking for a full refund under U.S. DOT rules.
- Payments are handled by a named merchant of record shown at checkout.
